---
title: Images
---

IMAGES_PAGE_MARKER

A markdown image with no author-supplied dimensions — the renderer should pull its
width/height from the sync-time dimensions manifest and hand it to next/image.

![Hero](/img/hero.png)

An external image stays a plain lazy `<img>` (the optimizer can't enumerate remote hosts):

![Remote](https://example.com/remote.png)

A literal `<img>` tag (the dominant form in representative docs repos, often inside `<Frame>`)
must optimize identically to a markdown image — it must NOT bypass next/image:

<Frame>
  <img src="/img/wide.png" alt="Wide" />
</Frame>
